question: Who has access to the presidential daily briefing?
text:
The **President’s Daily Brief (PDB)** goes to the U.S. president, the vice president, and a small group of senior officials chosen by the president. That list can vary by administration, but it has often included the national security adviser and the secretaries of state and defense. ([cia.gov](https://www.cia.gov/about/organization/directorate-of-analysis/?utm_source=openai))

Members of Congress do not routinely receive the PDB. It is highly classified, though some historical briefs have been declassified and released to the public. ([cia.gov](https://www.cia.gov/about/organization/directorate-of-analysis/?utm_source=openai))
